player_prompt.intro:
Keddaɣ ad tekkiɣ {player_id}. Tekkiɣ ɣasri n uzzal n 15.
Tawuri n uzzal ad d-yezzi tileɣɣa n uɛdaw s wassaɣ ɣer 15, d akal n lebɣer deg wadda n walu.
I wakken ad tekkeɣ tileɣɣa, tzemreɣ ad tesseɣɣeɣ tileɣɣa ɣer akal n lebɣer (yettwaban ɣer snat n tedɣaɣ, am __) s useqdec n yiwen n isallen-a:
- 'up': Selleɣ tileɣɣa n wadda n akal n lebɣer ɣer ufella.
- 'down': Selleɣ tileɣɣa n ufella n akal n lebɣer ɣer wadda.
- 'left': Selleɣ tileɣɣa n walu n akal n lebɣer ɣer ayfus.
- 'right': Selleɣ tileɣɣa n ayfus n akal n lebɣer ɣer walu.
I wakken ad tessuteɣ tileɣɣa, iraɣ isallen (am 'up', 'down', 'left', neɣ 'right') deg tneɣalin, am [up].
Tawuri n uzzal n tura yettwaban ɣer walu. Sqedceɣ isallen-a i wakken ad tessuteɣ uzzal.
